description: Land Acquisition - Doradeniya, Henepola, Dewatagedara & Kehelwaththehena, Polgahawela D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific parcels of land being acquired by the government, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and exact measurements. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in the "PART III - LANDS" section of the gazette.
